reviewLimits: Metadata/provenance change to exactly four existing formula IDs; their LaTeX, names, plain forms and theory links stay identical.
The original 1969 CHSH full text was not inspected; reviewed normalizations use Brunner v3 and Cirelson pp. 93–95. No original-paper equation locator is fabricated.
WJD v3 is projective in its quantum examples; its mixture illustrates the local model without turning the Bell condition itself into a projective-measurement requirement.
Cirelson 1980 scanned pages 1–3 were visually inspected. Brunner v3 pages 3 and 21 were inspected; historical open-problem status elsewhere in that review is not imported.
Numerical checks validate explicit examples and negative controls, not a new experimental result or an exhaustive Bell-locality decision method.
